note: RA2 (not Yuri's Revenge) Soviet data from original rules; costs are standard, prerequisites and power values are approximate. The observed sidebar is authoritative for availability. short: the name on unit overlays; cargo: a transport (shows cargo pips under it when selected).

lanes.buildings: Structures tab: one building is constructed at a time, then placed.
lanes.defenses: Defense tab: one defensive structure at a time, then placed.
lanes.infantry: Barracks queue: trains infantry one after another.
lanes.vehicles: War factory queue: builds vehicles one after another.

tesla_reactor.name: Tesla Reactor
tesla_reactor.role: Power plant; every other building needs power.

ore_refinery.name: Ore Refinery
ore_refinery.role: Processes ore into credits; comes with one War Miner.

radar_tower.name: Radar Tower
radar_tower.role: Enables the minimap and unlocks advanced units.

battle_lab.name: Soviet Battle Lab
battle_lab.role: Unlocks top-tier units such as Apocalypse Tanks and Kirovs.

nuclear_reactor.name: Nuclear Reactor
nuclear_reactor.role: Very large power output; dangerous if destroyed.

naval_shipyard.name: Soviet Naval Shipyard
naval_shipyard.role: Builds ships; must be placed on water.

conscript.name: Conscript
conscript.role: Cheap rifle infantry, good against infantry.

attack_dog.name: Attack Dog
attack_dog.role: Fast unit that kills infantry and detects spies.

desolator.name: Desolator
desolator.role: Iraqi radiation infantry effective against ground infantry and light vehicles. Deployed radiation also harms friendly infantry and vehicles; keep it away from dogs and the tank army.

crazy_ivan.name: Crazy Ivan
crazy_ivan.role: Plants bombs on buildings and units.

war_miner.name: War Miner
war_miner.role: Armored ore collector; more miners raise income.

rhino_tank.name: Rhino Tank
rhino_tank.role: Main battle tank, strong against vehicles and buildings.

terror_drone.name: Terror Drone
terror_drone.role: Fast drone that destroys vehicles from inside.

apocalypse_tank.name: Apocalypse Tank
apocalypse_tank.role: Heavy tank, strong against ground and air.

kirov_airship.name: Kirov Airship
kirov_airship.role: Slow bomber airship that levels bases.

mcv.name: Mobile Construction Vehicle
mcv.role: Deploys into a new construction yard.
